title: Dana-RS Bluetooth connection fails on AAPS v3.4.0.0+ (Works on v3.3.2.1)
symptom: Bluetooth connection to Dana-RS pump fails on AndroidAPS versions 3.4.0.0 and above. Tapping the Bluetooth icon on the Pump page starts a progress timer that counts to 120 seconds but never connects. Version 3.3.2.1 works fine.
cause: A bug in AAPS 3.4.x affecting Korean Dana-RS pumps, fixed in the dev3 branch.
fix: Test the dev3 branch version, which includes a fix for the Korean RS pump connection issue. The fix is expected to be included in the next 3.4 release.
evidence_quote: are you able to test version in dev3 branch? It's 3.4 + some fixes including fix for korean RS
